incline-dumbbell-press.coachingSummary: Upper chest press using dumbbells on an incline bench with a controlled range of motion.

barbell-bench-press.coachingSummary: Foundational horizontal press for chest, shoulder, and triceps strength.

pull-ups.coachingSummary: Bodyweight vertical pull emphasizing the lats, upper back, biceps, and grip.

barbell-deadlift.coachingSummary: Heavy hip hinge for posterior-chain strength, trunk bracing, and grip.

barbell-back-squat.coachingSummary: Barbell squat emphasizing quadriceps and glutes with full-body bracing.

dumbbell-shoulder-press.coachingSummary: Seated dumbbell overhead press for shoulder and triceps strength.

dumbbell-lateral-raise.coachingSummary: Shoulder isolation emphasizing the lateral deltoids with controlled arm elevation.

cable-triceps-pushdown.coachingSummary: Cable elbow extension that trains the triceps through a controlled range.

barbell-bicep-curl.coachingSummary: Standing curl for biceps and forearm flexors using a barbell or EZ-bar.

parallel-bar-dips.coachingSummary: Parallel-bar press emphasizing the chest and triceps with controlled shoulder depth.

hanging-leg-raise.coachingSummary: Hanging trunk and hip flexion for the abdominals, hip flexors, and grip.

romanian-deadlift.coachingSummary: Controlled hip hinge emphasizing the hamstrings and glutes under load.

push-up.coachingSummary: Bodyweight horizontal press with the trunk braced in a straight line from head to heels.

knee-push-up.coachingSummary: Push-up from the knees, keeping the trunk braced while reducing the load.

wall-push-up.coachingSummary: Standing push-up against a wall, the lowest-load entry into horizontal pressing.

incline-push-up.coachingSummary: Push-up with the hands elevated, reducing load while keeping a full range of motion.

wide-push-up.coachingSummary: Push-up with a wider hand position, shifting emphasis toward the chest.

dumbbell-bench-press.coachingSummary: Flat dumbbell press allowing a deeper stretch and independent arm paths.

incline-bench-press.coachingSummary: Barbell press on an incline, shifting emphasis toward the upper chest and front delts.

machine-chest-press.coachingSummary: Guided horizontal press that trains the chest with little balance demand.

dumbbell-fly.coachingSummary: Chest isolation through a wide arc with the elbows held at a fixed soft angle.

cable-fly.coachingSummary: Cable chest fly holding constant tension across the whole arc.

pec-deck.coachingSummary: Machine chest fly on a fixed path, useful for chest volume at low skill cost.

weighted-push-up.coachingSummary: Push-up loaded with external weight once bodyweight reps stop being challenging.

overhead-press.coachingSummary: Standing barbell press overhead with the trunk braced and the ribs down.

push-press.coachingSummary: Overhead press driven by a short leg dip, allowing heavier loads than a strict press.

standing-dumbbell-press.coachingSummary: Standing dumbbell press overhead with independent arm paths and a braced trunk.

arnold-press.coachingSummary: Dumbbell press overhead with rotation, covering front and lateral deltoid ranges.

machine-shoulder-press.coachingSummary: Guided press overhead for shoulder volume with little balance demand.

pike-push-up.coachingSummary: Bodyweight vertical press with the hips high, loading the shoulders and triceps.

front-raise.coachingSummary: Front deltoid isolation raising the load to shoulder height under control.

cable-lateral-raise.coachingSummary: Cable lateral raise holding tension on the side deltoid through the whole range.

close-grip-bench-press.coachingSummary: Narrow-grip bench press shifting emphasis from the chest to the triceps.

dip.coachingSummary: Bodyweight dip on parallel bars, pressing the chest and triceps through a deep range.

bench-dip.coachingSummary: Triceps dip with the hands behind on a bench and the feet supported.

diamond-push-up.coachingSummary: Push-up with the hands close together, emphasizing the triceps.

assisted-dip.coachingSummary: Machine-assisted dip that carries part of bodyweight while the pattern is learned.

dumbbell-overhead-tricep-extension.coachingSummary: Elbow extension overhead, loading the triceps in a lengthened position.

skull-crusher.coachingSummary: Lying elbow extension keeping the upper arms still as the bar travels past the head.

rope-tricep-pushdown.coachingSummary: Cable pushdown with a rope, letting the hands separate at lockout.

barbell-row.coachingSummary: Bent-over barbell row pulling to the lower ribs from a braced hinge.

pendlay-row.coachingSummary: Barbell row from a dead stop on the floor each rep, which removes momentum.

dumbbell-bent-over-row.coachingSummary: Bent-over dumbbell row training the mid-back from a braced hinge position.

one-arm-dumbbell-row.coachingSummary: Single-arm row with the free hand supported, allowing a long controlled pull.

seated-row.coachingSummary: Seated cable row pulling to the trunk with the chest tall and the shoulders down.

machine-row.coachingSummary: Guided rowing pattern for mid-back volume with little balance demand.

chest-supported-row.coachingSummary: Row with the chest supported, taking the lower back out of the movement.

inverted-row.coachingSummary: Bodyweight row under a fixed bar, scaled by how horizontal the body is.

banded-row.coachingSummary: Band row giving a horizontal pull wherever an anchor is available.

lat-pulldown.coachingSummary: Cable pulldown training the vertical pull at a load that can be dialed in.

wide-grip-lat-pulldown.coachingSummary: Wide-grip pulldown emphasizing the lats through a vertical pulling path.

close-grip-lat-pulldown.coachingSummary: Close-grip pulldown with a longer range and more elbow flexion than a wide grip.

assisted-pull-up.coachingSummary: Machine-assisted pull-up that carries part of bodyweight while strength is built.

negative-pull-up.coachingSummary: The lowering half of a pull-up performed slowly, a step toward the full movement.

neutral-grip-pull-up.coachingSummary: Pull-up with the palms facing each other, often the most shoulder-friendly grip.

banded-lat-pulldown.coachingSummary: Band pulldown giving a vertical pull without a cable stack.

straight-arm-pulldown.coachingSummary: Lat isolation drawing the bar down with the elbows held nearly straight.

face-pull.coachingSummary: Cable pull to the face training the rear delts and the upper-back rotators.

band-pull-apart.coachingSummary: Band pulled apart at chest height, low-fatigue upper-back and rear-delt work.

shrug.coachingSummary: Barbell shrug elevating the shoulders to train the upper traps.

dumbbell-shrug.coachingSummary: Dumbbell shrug training the upper traps with the arms hanging at the sides.

prone-y-raise.coachingSummary: Face-down raise in a Y position for the lower traps and upper back.

bicep-curl.coachingSummary: Dumbbell curl training the biceps with a supinated grip.

hammer-curl.coachingSummary: Neutral-grip curl loading the biceps and the brachialis beneath them.

cable-curl.coachingSummary: Cable curl holding tension on the biceps through the whole range.

incline-dumbbell-curl.coachingSummary: Curl lying back on an incline, loading the biceps in a stretched position.

preacher-curl.coachingSummary: Curl with the upper arms supported, which takes swing out of the movement.

chin-up.coachingSummary: Underhand-grip pull-up placing more of the work on the biceps.

rear-delt-fly.coachingSummary: Bent-over dumbbell fly training the rear deltoids.

cable-rear-delt-fly.coachingSummary: Cable reverse fly keeping tension on the rear deltoids throughout.

reverse-pec-deck.coachingSummary: Machine reverse fly for rear-delt volume on a fixed movement path.

reverse-curl.coachingSummary: Overhand curl loading the forearm extensors and the brachioradialis.

wrist-curl.coachingSummary: Wrist flexion against load, direct work for the forearm flexors and grip.

bodyweight-squat.coachingSummary: Unloaded squat used to groove the pattern and build a base.

goblet-squat.coachingSummary: Squat holding a single weight at the chest, which helps keep the torso upright.

front-squat.coachingSummary: Barbell squat with the bar racked on the front delts, demanding an upright trunk.

leg-press.coachingSummary: Machine press loading the legs heavily with the back supported.

hack-squat.coachingSummary: Guided squat on a fixed path, biasing the quadriceps.

leg-extension.coachingSummary: Knee extension isolating the quadriceps with the thighs supported.

bulgarian-split-squat.coachingSummary: Rear-foot-elevated split squat, a demanding single-leg squat pattern.

walking-lunge.coachingSummary: Alternating forward lunges traveling across the floor.

forward-lunge.coachingSummary: Lunge stepping forward and returning, training each leg in turn.

reverse-lunge.coachingSummary: Lunge stepping backward, usually gentler on the knees than stepping forward.

step-up.coachingSummary: Single-leg step onto a box, driving through the working leg.

hip-thrust.coachingSummary: Barbell thrust from a bench, loading the glutes at the top of hip extension.

dumbbell-hip-thrust.coachingSummary: Hip thrust loaded with a dumbbell across the hips.

glute-bridge.coachingSummary: Floor bridge extending the hips against bodyweight.

single-leg-glute-bridge.coachingSummary: Bridge driven by one leg at a time, adding load without equipment.

cable-pull-through.coachingSummary: Cable hinge pulling from between the legs, which teaches hip drive at light load.

kettlebell-swing.coachingSummary: Ballistic hip hinge swinging the bell to chest height on a sharp glute snap.

dumbbell-sumo-squat.coachingSummary: Wide-stance squat holding a dumbbell, emphasizing the glutes and adductors.

hip-abduction-machine.coachingSummary: Seated abduction machine isolating the outer hip.

sumo-deadlift.coachingSummary: Wide-stance deadlift with a more upright trunk than the conventional pull.

trap-bar-deadlift.coachingSummary: Deadlift from a trap bar with neutral handles, often easier on the lower back.

dumbbell-romanian-deadlift.coachingSummary: Hip hinge with dumbbells, loading the hamstrings under control.

kettlebell-romanian-deadlift.coachingSummary: Kettlebell hinge training the hamstrings and glutes at lighter loads.

good-morning.coachingSummary: Barbell hinge with the bar on the back, which demands careful bracing.

leg-curl.coachingSummary: Machine knee flexion isolating the hamstrings.

seated-leg-curl.coachingSummary: Seated knee flexion training the hamstrings with the hips flexed.

single-leg-romanian-deadlift.coachingSummary: Single-leg hinge training the hamstrings while demanding balance.

calf-raise.coachingSummary: Bodyweight heel raise training the calves through a full range.

standing-calf-raise.coachingSummary: Loaded standing heel raise, biasing the gastrocnemius.

seated-calf-raise.coachingSummary: Seated heel raise with the knees bent, biasing the soleus.

single-leg-calf-raise.coachingSummary: Heel raise on one leg at a time, adding load without equipment.

back-extension.coachingSummary: Trunk extension training the spinal erectors and glutes.

superman.coachingSummary: Face-down raise of the arms and legs, low-load work for the spinal erectors.

hip-adduction-machine.coachingSummary: Seated adduction machine isolating the inner thigh.

crunch.coachingSummary: Short-range trunk flexion training the abdominals.

reverse-crunch.coachingSummary: Trunk flexion driven by lifting the hips, loading the lower abdominals.

dead-bug.coachingSummary: Anti-extension drill moving opposite limbs while the lower back stays flat.

bird-dog.coachingSummary: Quadruped drill extending opposite limbs while the trunk resists rotation.

hanging-knee-raise.coachingSummary: Hanging knee raise, the usual step before full hanging leg raises.

lying-leg-raise.coachingSummary: Floor leg raise training the lower abdominals and hip flexors.

cable-crunch.coachingSummary: Kneeling cable crunch, which lets abdominal work be loaded progressively.

pallof-press.coachingSummary: Anti-rotation press holding the trunk square against a sideways pull.

ab-wheel.coachingSummary: Rollout demanding strong anti-extension control through the trunk.

v-up.coachingSummary: Simultaneous leg and torso raise meeting over the hips.
